title: NATS: Write individual operation names into INFO column
description:
This makes it easier to keep an overview of what's happening in the communication.
Also move the write to the PROTOCOL column to the top of the dissection function
so it is called before subdissectors. This ensures information appended by them
(e.g. "/JSON") is not overwritten.
![Updated_Columns](/uploads/50cd4b66ea45c82382714fcd93f0a2bc/Updated_Columns.png){width=299 height=61}

notes.body: If performance is important, if there's a lot of command types it could be better to register a case insensitive string dissector table and set each of these functions to the string that they dissect so that the token is looked up in a hash table instead of a bunch of tvb_strcasecmp calls. That's a future idea.
